freaky-forester-random-event-initial-dia.npc: Hey, [player name], can you come and help me with some pheasants?

options.text: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.

steps.player: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.

steps.text: Player is teleported to the Freaky Forester random event area.

freaky-forester-random-event-in-the-fore.text: The number of tails on the pheasant is randomized.

steps.npc: Hey there, [player name]. Could you kill a pheasant with [two/three/four] tails, please? Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
Hey there, [player name]. Can you kill the [2/3/4]-tailed pheasant please. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
Hey there, [player name]. I need you to kill a pheasant that has [2/3/4] tails. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.

freaky-forester-random-event-after-killi.npc: Now bring me the raw pheasant.

freaky-forester-random-event-after-killi.text: The player brings the pheasant to the Freaky Forester.

freaky-forester-random-event-after-killi.npc: Thanks, [player name], you may use the portal to leave the area now.
Okay, [player name], you can leave the area now.

freaky-forester-random-event-attempting-.text: You don't need to attack any more pheasants. You're allowed to leave.

freaky-forester-random-event-attempting-.npc: I don't need any more of those. You are free to exit the area now.

freaky-forester-random-event-leaving-the.text: If the player has not completed the lederhosen outfit:

steps.npc: You get a lederhosen [hat/top/shorts] for your help, many thanks!

freaky-forester-random-event-leaving-the.text: If the player has completed the lederhosen outfit:

steps.npc: You get a lamp for your help, many thanks!

overhead-dialogue.text: Upon spawning in for the player & waiting for a response by the player:

steps.npc: I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
